text.tspan: Share of women in top income groups UK
Percentage of individuals falling into top income brackets that are women. Figures relate to total income before
tax, including earned, investment and self-employment income.

tspan.tspan: The income concept in general does not include capital gains, but the degree to which this holds varies between countries.
